title: Data Domains & Concepts ↔ Interface Catalogue Matrix
description: Many-to-many mapping between conceptual data entities in the Data Domains & Concepts Catalogue (DAT-DAC) and the interfaces in the Interface Catalogue (INT-IFC) that carry them.

meta.description: Maps each INT-IFC interface to the DAT-DAC concepts that flow across it.
purpose: Shows which conceptual data entities flow across which interfaces, and surfaces concepts with no integration coverage
Supports impact analysis — if a concept's definition changes, which interfaces need review?
Provides traceability from the conceptual data model (the what) through to the integration landscape (how it moves)

$schema.description: URN of the schema this instance conforms to (this file's $id).

relationships.description: Sparse list of mappings between DAT-DAC concepts (columns) and INT-IFC interfaces (rows). An entry's presence means the concept flows across the interface; absence means no mapping.
